name: Shared current combat receiving qualification

on:
  push:
    branches: [lab/shared-current-combat-receiving]
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/shared-current-combat-qualification.yml'
      - 'lab-coordinator/shared-capabilities/current-combat-*'
      - 'lab-coordinator/shared-capabilities/current-combat-authority/**'
      - 'rules-engine/**'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  qualify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 35
    env:
      GRADLE_LOCK_SLOTS: '1'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '21'
      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v6
      - uses: extractions/setup-just@f8a3cce218d9f83db3a2ecd90e41ac3de6cdfd9b
      - name: Bind exact receiving source and preserved four-bank authority
        env:
          EXPECTED_SOURCE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,subprocess
          path=pathlib.Path('lab-coordinator/shared-capabilities/current-combat-receiving.json')
          raw=path.read_bytes(); manifest=json.loads(raw)
          head=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()
          tree=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD^{tree}'],text=True).strip()
          assert head==os.environ['EXPECTED_SOURCE']
          assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain'],text=True).strip()
          subprocess.run(['git','merge-base','--is-ancestor',manifest['receiving_base'],'HEAD'],check=True)
          for filename,expected in manifest['source_files_sha256'].items():
              assert hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(filename).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected,filename
          assert len(manifest['stages'])==4 and sum(s['expected_cases'] for s in manifest['stages'])==32
          assert [b['class'] for b in manifest['banks']]==[s['class'] for s in manifest['stages']]
          workflow='.github/workflows/shared-current-combat-qualification.yml'
          source={**manifest['source_files_sha256'],workflow:hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(workflow).read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
          out=pathlib.Path('build/reports/shared-current-combat'); out.mkdir(parents=True)
          (out/'source-provenance.json').write_text(json.dumps({'candidate_head':head,'tree':tree,
              'manifest_sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'source_sha256':source,
              'official_games':0,'gameplay_authorized':False},indent=2)+'\n')
          PY
      - name: Execute the original thirty-two deterministic cases
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set +e
          set -o pipefail
          just test-class CombatAssignmentCurrentRulesTest \
            --tests '*CombatResolutionBoardTest' --tests '*CombatDamageAssignmentTest' \
            --tests '*BandingTrampleDrainScenarioTest' --rerun --info --stacktrace \
            --max-workers=1 -PkotlinCompileParallelism=1 \
            -Pkotlin.compiler.execution.strategy=in-process -Dorg.gradle.jvmargs=-Xmx4g \
            2>&1 | tee build/reports/shared-current-combat/qualification.log
          status=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
          printf '%s\n' "$status" > build/reports/shared-current-combat/command-exit-status.txt
          exit 0
      - name: Reconcile raw cases with the unchanged shared collector
        if: always()
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import hashlib,importlib.util,json,pathlib,shutil,subprocess
          root=pathlib.Path('.'); out=root/'build/reports/shared-current-combat'; out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
          path=root/'lab-coordinator/shared-capabilities/current-combat-receiving.json'; raw=path.read_bytes(); manifest=json.loads(raw)
          errors=[]
          try:
              source=json.loads((out/'source-provenance.json').read_text())
              assert source['candidate_head']==subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()
              assert source['tree']==subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD^{tree}'],text=True).strip()
              assert source['manifest_sha256']==hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
              for filename,expected in source['source_sha256'].items():
                  assert hashlib.sha256((root/filename).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected,filename
              assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain'],text=True).strip()
          except (OSError,ValueError,KeyError,AssertionError) as exc:
              errors.append('Exact receiving source binding failed: '+str(exc))
          for stage in manifest['stages']:
              folder=out/'tests'/stage['stage']; folder.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
              status=out/'command-exit-status.txt'
              if status.is_file(): shutil.copyfile(status,folder/'exit-status.txt')
              xml=root/stage['module']/'build/test-results/test'/('TEST-'+stage['class']+'.xml')
              if xml.is_file(): shutil.copyfile(xml,folder/xml.name)
          spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('shared_collector','lab-coordinator/shared-capabilities/collect-priority-receiving.py')
          collector=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(collector)
          rows,case_errors=collector.collect_case_rows(out,manifest['stages']); errors.extend(case_errors)
          actual=sum(r.get('actual_cases',0) for r in rows)
          if len(rows)!=4 or actual!=32: errors.append('Original four-bank32 scope incomplete')
          for bank,row in zip(manifest['banks'],rows):
              if set(row.get('case_names',[]))!=set(bank['case_names']): errors.append('Frozen case identities differ: '+bank['class'])
          (out/'actual-case-audit.json').write_text(json.dumps({'status':'INCOMPLETE_OR_FAILED' if errors else 'PASS_REQUIRES_INDEPENDENT_ARTIFACT_REVIEW',
              'stages':rows,'actual_cases':actual,'errors':errors,'official_games':0,'gameplay_authorized':False},indent=2)+'\n')
          print(json.dumps({'actual_cases':actual,'errors':errors}))
          raise SystemExit(1 if errors else 0)
          PY
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        if: always()
        with:
          name: shared-current-combat-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: build/reports/shared-current-combat/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 90
